source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Unit 7 (PDF 128-144), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 7 (Permutation and Combination) ke poore unit se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke Section-II ke sawal ke hisse ki shakal mein: har sawal 5 number ka hai (lamba sawal, saboot (proof) ya derivation). Har sawal poore qadmon ke saath hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 State the Fundamental Principle of Counting. A canteen offers 4 sandwiches, 3 drinks and 2 desserts. How many meals of one sandwich, one drink and one dessert are possible? How many if the meal may also be taken without a dessert? (5 marks)
(Ginti ka bunyadi usool bayan karein. Canteen mein 4 sandwiches, 3 drinks aur 2 desserts hain. Aik sandwich, aik drink, aik dessert wale kitne khane? Agar dessert ke baghair bhi liya ja sake to kitne?)
blocks.explanation: Har marhala zarb hota hai; 'dessert nahin' dessert marhale ka aik aur option hai.

book_ref.quote: then the total number of ways that the two events together can occur is the product of m and n.

steps: Bayan: aik event \(m\) tareeqon se aur doosra \(n\) se ho to dono \(m \times n\) tareeqon se; teen ya zyada events par bhi.
Dessert ke baghair ki ijazat: dessert marhale ke \(3\) options.
blocks.final_answer: 24 khane; dessert chhorne ki ijazat ho to 36.

blocks.prompt:
2 Show that \(\frac{(n + 1)!}{(n - 1)!} = n^{2} + n\), and hence find \(n\) if \(\frac{(n + 1)!}{(n - 1)!} = 56\). (5 marks)
(Dikhayen ke \(\frac{(n + 1)!}{(n - 1)!} = n^{2} + n\), aur phir \(n\) nikalein agar \(\frac{(n + 1)!}{(n - 1)!} = 56\).)
blocks.explanation: \((n + 1)! = (n + 1)\,n\,(n - 1)!\) likh kar cancel karein, phir quadratic hal karein.

book_ref.quote: Factorials grow very fast:

blocks.prompt:
3 Prove that \({}^{n}P_{r} = n(n - 1)(n - 2)\cdots(n - r + 1) = \frac{n!}{(n - r)!}\), and use it to explain why \(0! = 1\). (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke \({}^{n}P_{r} = n(n - 1)\cdots(n - r + 1) = \frac{n!}{(n - r)!}\), aur is se wazeh karein ke \(0! = 1\) kyun.)
blocks.explanation: \(r\) jagahen aik aik kar ke bunyadi usool se bharein, phir \((n - r)!\) se zarb aur taqseem.

book_ref.quote: Since repetitions are not allowed, after placing one object we are left with

steps: \(n\) mein se \(r\) cheezen \(r\) jagahon par. Pehli jagah \(n\) tareeqe; baghair dohraye doosri \(n - 1\), teesri \(n - 2\).
\(r\)th jagah se pehle \(r - 1\) cheezen lag chuki, to \(n - r + 1\) tareeqe.
\((n - r)!\) se zarb aur taqseem: \({}^{n}P_{r} = \frac{n!}{(n - r)!}\).
\(r = n\): \(n!\) tareeqe, formula \(\frac{n!}{0!}\) deta hai; is liye \(0! = 1\).

blocks.prompt:
4 4-digit numbers are formed from the digits 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 without repetition. How many are (i) possible in all (ii) even (iii) greater than 5000 (iv) greater than 5000 and even? (5 marks)
(Digits 1 se 7 tak se baghair dohraye 4-digit numbers banaye jate hain. Kitne (i) kul (ii) jufat (iii) 5000 se bare (iv) 5000 se bare aur jufat?)
blocks.explanation: Hamesha pabandi wali jagah pehle bharein; (iv) mein pehli digit jufat hai ya nahin, is par cases banayen.

book_ref.quote: The thousands place has 6 choices, then 5, 4 and 3 for the remaining places.

blocks.prompt:
5 5 different Urdu, 2 different English and 3 different Islamiat books are to be placed on a shelf. In how many ways can this be done if (i) there is no condition (ii) books of each subject are together (iii) only the English books must be together? (5 marks)
(5 mukhtalif Urdu, 2 English aur 3 Islamiat ki kitaben shelf par. Kitne tareeqe agar (i) koi shart nahin (ii) har mazmoon ki kitaben ikatthi (iii) sirf English kitaben ikatthi?)
blocks.explanation: Jo group ikattha rahe use aik block samjhein; blocks ki tarteeb, phir har block ke andar tarteeb.

book_ref.quote: forgetting the 3! that arranges the subject blocks themselves

blocks.prompt:
6 4 boys and 3 girls are to stand in a row. In how many ways can they stand if (i) no two girls are next to each other (ii) all the girls are together? (5 marks)
(4 larke aur 3 larkiyan qataar mein. Kitne tareeqe agar (i) koi do larkiyan saath na hon (ii) tamam larkiyan ikatthi hon?)
blocks.explanation: (i) Gap tareeqa: pehle larke, phir larkiyan khaali jagahon mein. (ii) Block tareeqa.

book_ref.quote: this leaves 4 gaps, and the 3 people take 3 of them in

blocks.prompt:
7 In how many ways can 6 people sit on a bench if (i) there is no condition (ii) two particular people sit together (iii) these two do not sit together? (5 marks)
(6 log bench par kitne tareeqon se baith sakte hain agar (i) koi shart nahin (ii) do khaas log saath (iii) yeh do saath na hon?)
blocks.explanation: 'Saath' ke liye block tareeqa, 'saath nahin' ke liye kul mein se tafreeq.

book_ref.quote: every seating either has A and B together or not

steps: (iii) Har tarteeb mein yeh do ya saath hain ya alag.

blocks.prompt:
8 Find the number of arrangements of the letters of the word STATISTICS. How many of them begin and end with S? (5 marks)
(Lafz STATISTICS ke huroof ki tarteeben nikalein. In mein se kitni S se shuru aur S par khatam hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har dohraye harf ki ginti, \(\frac{n!}{n_{1}!\,n_{2}!\cdots}\); doosre hisse mein do S fix kar ke darmiyani 8 ki tarteeb.

book_ref.quote: Adding the repeats instead of taking their factorials

steps: 10 huroof: S 3, T 3, I 2, A 1, C 1.
Dono siron par S fix; darmiyan 8 huroof T, A, T, I, T, I, C, S.
blocks.final_answer: 50400 tarteeben; 3360 S se shuru aur S par khatam.

blocks.prompt:
9 Find the number of arrangements of the letters of BALLOON. In how many of them are the two L together, and in how many are they not together? (5 marks)
(BALLOON ke huroof ki tarteeben nikalein. Kitni mein do L saath hain aur kitni mein saath nahin?)
blocks.explanation: Aik jaisi cheezon wala formula; 'saath' ke liye LL ko aik harf samjhein, 'saath nahin' ke liye tafreeq.

book_ref.quote: so every real word has been counted

steps: LL aik harf: B, A, (LL), O, O, N = 6 units, O do dafa.

blocks.prompt:
10 Explain why \(n\) different objects can be arranged in a circle in \((n - 1)!\) ways, and in \(\frac{(n - 1)!}{2}\) ways when clockwise and anticlockwise orders are the same. Hence find the number of seatings of 8 people at a round table and of necklaces of 8 different beads. (5 marks)
(Wazeh karein ke \(n\) mukhtalif cheezen daire mein \((n - 1)!\) tareeqon se, aur clockwise/anticlockwise aik hon to \(\frac{(n - 1)!}{2}\) tareeqon se kyun. Phir 8 logon ki gol mez aur 8 mukhtalif motiyon ke haar nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Gardish se naya daira nahin banta, is liye aik cheez fix; haar palta ja sakta hai, is liye aadha.

book_ref.quote: fix one person's seat (rotation no longer matters)

steps: Qataar mein \(n!\). Daire ki gardish se wohi tarteeb; har daira \(n\) qataaron ke barabar.
Palti ja sakne wali (haar) mein tarteeb aur aks aik: \(\frac{(n - 1)!}{2}\), \(n \ge 3\) (Case-II).

blocks.prompt:
11 7 people are to sit at a round table. In how many ways can they sit if (i) there is no condition (ii) two particular people sit together (iii) these two do not sit together? (5 marks)
(7 log gol mez par. Kitne tareeqe agar (i) koi shart nahin (ii) do khaas log saath (iii) yeh do saath na hon?)
blocks.explanation: Case-I circular ginti; saath ke liye block; alag ke liye tafreeq.

blocks.prompt:
12 Prove that \({}^{n}C_{r} = \frac{n!}{r!\,(n - r)!}\). Deduce that \({}^{n}C_{n} = {}^{n}C_{0} = 1\), and verify the formula for \({}^{9}C_{4}\). (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke \({}^{n}C_{r} = \frac{n!}{r!\,(n - r)!}\). Is se \({}^{n}C_{n} = {}^{n}C_{0} = 1\) nikalein, aur \({}^{9}C_{4}\) par tasdeeq karein.)
blocks.explanation: Har combination se \(r!\) permutations, is liye \({}^{n}C_{r} \times r! = {}^{n}P_{r}\).

book_ref.quote: So, each combination will give rise to

steps: Har \(r\) cheezon ka combination \(r!\) tarteeben deta hai; kul \({}^{n}C_{r} \times r!\).
Yeh tamam permutations hain: \({}^{n}C_{r} \times r! = \frac{n!}{(n - r)!}\).

blocks.prompt:
13 10 points lie in a plane and no three of them are on one straight line. Find the number of (i) straight lines (ii) triangles (iii) quadrilaterals (choosing 4 vertices) that can be formed. Also, how many handshakes take place among 10 people? (5 marks)
(Satah mein 10 nuqte, koi teen aik seedhi line par nahin. Kitni (i) lines (ii) triangles (iii) quadrilaterals (4 vertices chun kar) ban sakti hain? 10 logon mein kitne handshakes?)
blocks.explanation: Har shakal chune hue nuqton se banti hai, tarteeb se nahin: combinations.

book_ref.quote: A combination of \(r\) objects taken out of \(n\) objects is a subset of

steps: Handshake aik jora hai, tarteeb ahem nahin.

blocks.prompt:
14 A committee of 5 is to be chosen from 7 men and 5 women. In how many ways can this be done if the committee contains (i) exactly 2 women (ii) at least 4 women (iii) no woman (iv) at most one woman? (5 marks)
(7 mardon aur 5 auraton mein se 5 ki committee. Kitne tareeqe agar committee mein (i) theek 2 auraten (ii) kam az kam 4 auraten (iii) koi aurat nahin (iv) zyada se zyada aik aurat?)
blocks.explanation: Mard aur auraten alag chunein aur zarb karein; 'kam az kam' ya 'zyada se zyada' mein cases jama karein.

book_ref.quote: Girls AND boys are chosen together, so multiply.

blocks.prompt:
15 A team of 5 players is to be chosen from 9 players. In how many ways can it be chosen if (i) there is no condition (ii) a particular player must be in the team (iii) that player must be left out? Show that (ii) and (iii) together give (i). (5 marks)
(9 khilariyon mein se 5 ki team. Kitne tareeqe agar (i) koi shart nahin (ii) aik khaas khilari zaroor ho (iii) woh khilari bahar ho? Dikhayen ke (ii) aur (iii) mil kar (i) dete hain.)
blocks.explanation: Khaas khilari ko pehle andar (ya bahar) karein, phir baqi doosron mein se.

book_ref.quote: the remaining 3 places must still be filled with boys

steps: Har team mein woh ya hai ya nahin; koi team dono mein nahin.

blocks.prompt:
16 Prove that \({}^{n}C_{r} = {}^{n}C_{n - r}\). Hence evaluate \({}^{50}C_{48}\) and find \(n\) if \({}^{n}C_{3} = {}^{n}C_{9}\). (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke \({}^{n}C_{r} = {}^{n}C_{n - r}\). Phir \({}^{50}C_{48}\) nikalein aur \(n\) nikalein agar \({}^{n}C_{3} = {}^{n}C_{9}\).)
blocks.explanation: Formula mein \(r\) ki jagah \(n - r\) rakh kar muqabla; phir \(r\) aur \(n - r\) mein chhota lein.

book_ref.quote: Corresponding to every combination of

steps: Yeh \({}^{n}C_{r}\) hai. (Har \(r\) ka intikhab \(n - r\) ka aik group chhorta hai.)

blocks.prompt:
17 Show that a polygon of \(n\) sides has \(\frac{n(n - 3)}{2}\) diagonals. Find the number of diagonals of a 10-sided polygon, and the number of sides of a polygon with 44 diagonals. (5 marks)
(Dikhayen ke \(n\) sides wale polygon ke \(\frac{n(n - 3)}{2}\) diagonals hote hain. 10 sides wale polygon ke diagonals aur 44 diagonals wale polygon ke sides nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Koi bhi 2 vertices aik segment; \(n\) sides nikal dein.

book_ref.quote: A diagonal joins two vertices that are not next to each other

blocks.final_answer: Diagonals = n(n - 3)/2; 10 sides par 35; 44 diagonals ka matlab 11 sides.

blocks.prompt:
18 A PIN of 4 characters is made from the 15 characters A to O. Find the number of PINs (i) if no character is repeated (ii) if characters may be repeated. If someone guesses one PIN at random, what is the chance of being right in each case? (5 marks)
(A se O tak 15 characters se 4 characters ka PIN. Kitne PIN (i) baghair dohraye (ii) dohrane ke saath? Aik PIN andaze se lagaya jaye to har surat mein sahi hone ka chance?)
blocks.explanation: PIN mein tarteeb ahem: baghair dohraye permutation, dohrane ke saath power.

book_ref.quote: With repetition each place has all 36 choices

steps: Tarteeb ahem: ABCD aur DCBA mukhtalif.

blocks.prompt:
19 Cards numbered 1 to 20 are in a box and 4 cards are drawn one by one. Hamid wins if he draws 5, 10, 15, 20. Find his chance of winning if (i) the cards must come in exactly that order (ii) the order does not matter. (5 marks)
(Dabbe mein 1 se 20 tak cards, 4 cards aik aik kar ke nikale jate hain. Hamid 5, 10, 15, 20 nikale to jeetta hai. Jeetne ka chance (i) agar bilkul isi tarteeb mein aayen (ii) agar tarteeb ahem na ho.)
blocks.explanation: Tarteeb wali \({}^{20}P_{4}\); baghair tarteeb \({}^{20}C_{4}\); har surat mein aik jeet.

book_ref.quote: This is why real lotteries where the order does not matter are counted with combinations.

blocks.prompt:
20 A singer knows 12 songs and will sing 4 of them in a programme. Find the number of programmes if (i) the order of the songs matters (ii) only the choice of songs matters. Show how the two answers are related. (5 marks)
(Gulukar 12 gaane janta hai aur programme mein 4 gaata hai. Kitne programme agar (i) gaanon ki tarteeb ahem ho (ii) sirf gaanon ka intikhab ahem ho? Dono jawabon ka taaluq dikhayen.)
blocks.explanation: Tarteeb wali list \({}^{12}P_{4}\); set \({}^{12}C_{4}\); har set ki \(4!\) tarteeben.
